ProjectKey.description: A project as the server knows it: the SHA-256, in lowercase hex, of its repository's normalised address. The server never learns the address; a teammate's host matches the hash against its own projects.

ShareRegistration.description: A project the account shares with one of its orgs, and the host that holds its record. Sent again with another host when the project's home moves.

ShareRemoval.description: A project the account no longer shares with the org.

ShareMove.description: Moves the account's registration of `from` with the org to `project`, a renamed project's new key or `from` itself, held by `host`, the project's home. Refused when the account no longer shares `from` with the org, so a move never brings back a share the person ended.

SharedProject.description: A project a teammate shares with the org, and the host to ask for its record.

member.description: The id of the teammate's membership in the org.

ShareMember.description: Someone in the org, by their membership id, the name they show and their account's picture.

you.description: Whether this is the account asking.

MemberName.description: The name a member shows their teammates: their account's name, or their membership id's first eight characters when it has none.

OrgShareList.description: One org whose Team plan is paid: its members, and the projects the others share with it.

shares.description: What the other members share; never the account's own.

mine.description: The account's own registrations with the org.

ShareRegistry.description: The share registry as one host sees it: each of its account's orgs whose Team plan is paid. shares.changed and orgs.changed say when to read it again.

PeerTicketRequest.description: Which teammate's host the asking host wants to read a shared project from, as a member of which org.

PeerTicket.description: The server's word that the host `from` belongs to a member of the org, for the host `to`, a teammate's host with a project shared with that org. The asking host shows it over ALPN sikemux/peer/1, and shows a new one before it runs out or the connection ends. The signature is the server's Ed25519 signature, with the join tickets' key, over the UTF-8 text `sikemux-peer|v1|<keyId>|<org>|<member>|<from>|<to>|<issuedAt>|<expiresAt>|<memberName>`, times in decimal.

member.description: The asking account's membership id in the org.
